   223  /-- If a function `f : E → H` is differentiable at `x`, sends a neighbourhood `u` of `x` to a
   224  closed convex set `s` with nonempty interior and has surjective differential at `x`, it must send
   225  `x` to the interior of `s`. -/
   226  lemma _root_.DifferentiableAt.mem_interior_convex_of_surjective_fderiv
   227      {E H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
   228      {f : E → H} {x : E} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) {u : Set E} (hu : u ∈ 𝓝 x) {s : Set H}
   229      (hs : Convex ℝ s) (hs' : IsClosed s) (hs'' : (interior s).Nonempty) (hfus : Set.MapsTo f u s)
   230      (hfx : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ f x)) : f x ∈ interior s := by
   231    contrapose hfx
   232    have ⟨F, hF⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_open_point hs.interior isOpen_interior hfx
   233    -- It suffices to show that `fderiv ℝ f x` sends everything to the kernel of `F`.
   234    suffices h : ∀ y, F (fderiv ℝ f x y) = 0 by
   235      have ⟨y, hy⟩ := hs''
   236      unfold Function.Surjective; push Not
   237      refine ⟨f x - y, fun z ↦ ne_of_apply_ne F ?_⟩
   238      rw [h z, F.map_sub]
   239      exact (sub_pos.2 <| hF _ hy).ne
   240    -- This follows from `F ∘ f` taking on a local maximum at `e.extend I x`.
   241    have hF' : MapsTo F s (Iic (F (f x))) := by
   242      rw [← hs'.closure_eq, ← closure_Iio, ← hs.closure_interior_eq_closure_of_nonempty_interior hs'']
   243      exact .closure hF F.continuous
   244    have hFφ : IsLocalMax (F ∘ f) x := Filter.eventually_of_mem hu fun y hy ↦ hF' <| hfus hy
   245    have h := hFφ.fderiv_eq_zero
   246    rw [fderiv_comp _ (by fun_prop) hf, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv] at h
   247    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h

   251  /-- For any two charts `e`, `e'` around a point `x` in a C¹ manifold, if `e` maps `x` to the
   252  interior of the model space, `e'` does too - in other words, the notion of interior points does not
   253  depend on any choice of charts.

   256  manifolds here. For merely topological finite-dimensional manifolds the proof involves singular
   257  homology, and for infinite-dimensional topological manifolds I don't even know if this lemma holds.

   259  lemma mem_interior_range_of_mem_interior_range_of_mem_atlas (hn : n ≠ 0)

   261      (hx : e.extend I x ∈ interior (e.extend I).target) :
   262      e'.extend I x ∈ interior (e'.extend I).target := by
   263    /- Since transition maps are diffeomorphisms, it suffices to show that if `e'` were to send `x`
   264    to the boundary of `range I`, the differential of the transition map `φ` from `e` to `e'` at `x`
   265    could not be surjective. -/
   266    let φ := I.extendCoordChange e e'
   267    have hφ : ContDiffOn 𝕜 n φ φ.source := contDiffOn_extendCoordChange
   268      (IsManifold.subset_maximalAtlas he) (IsManifold.subset_maximalAtlas he')
   269    suffices h : Function.Surjective (fderivWithin 𝕜 φ φ.source (e.extend I x)) →
   270        e'.extend I x ∈ interior (range I) by
